kagePct.label: damage for 3s after Shadow Step or a dodge

war.label: per hit taken in the last 5s

lionfist.label: per punch landed in the last 2s

demonknight.label: per chained strike in the last 3s

berserker.label: per hit taken in the last 5s

thunderforged.label: per blow landed in the last 2s

skyhawk.label: per long-range hit in the last 3s

dragoon.label: per shot fired in the last 2s

seraph.label: per Heal cast in the last 5s

war.name: Bulwark
war.text: every 5th blow is turned aside outright, and staggers what is in reach

hunt.name: Steady Aim
hunt.text: each strike on the same body is +6% attack speed, up to 5

shadow.name: Smoke Step
shadow.text: an evade guarantees the next strike crits — once every 4s

bushi.name: Riposte
bushi.text: a block makes the next strike within 2s land 40% harder

arcane.name: Attune
arcane.text: a skill leaves the body it hits 15% more open, to everything, for 4s

lionfist.name: King of Beasts
lionfist.text: every 16th punch readies Twin Lion Fists again

aegis.name: Mirror Aegis
aegis.text: every block throws the whole stopped blow back at the attacker

demonknight.name: Hellfire Chain
demonknight.text: the 4th link of a chain heals 5% and hurls a free Crescent Moon — once every 8s

berserker.name: Berserk
berserker.text: a Whirlwind started on a full Rage bar spins 50% longer and heals 30% of what it deals

thunderforged.name: Thunderstrike
thunderforged.text: Mjolnir calls lightning on everything it flies through, for 50% more

skyhawk.name: Sky Hunter
skyhawk.text: every 4th arrow that lands drops a Star Fall star on its target — every 2nd during Hawkeye

dragoon.name: Cavalry Charge
dragoon.text: the last round of every magazine throws a Grenade at 30% strength

kage.name: Shadow Clone
kage.text: a dodge leaves a shadow clone that fights beside you for 6s — once every 8s

lonewarrior.name: Lone Wolf
lonewarrior.text: Judgement Slash always crits, and every kill it makes refunds 30 Ki

seraph.name: Seraphic Wings
seraph.text: Resurrection's cooldown is halved, and every Heal smites what stands in Consecrate — or the 3 nearest enemies when none do

archmage.name: Elemental Chain
archmage.text: each skill makes the next DIFFERENT skill 30% stronger

gravebinder.name: Army of the Grave
gravebinder.text: a kill has a 25% chance to raise the fallen enemy to fight for you for 8s
